sonnet.problem: The True statement about seven pairs of birds just repeats what story card 3 said (7:3). It also tests two claims in one statement: the seven pairs, and the reason, to preserve their offspring.
sonnet.rule: A True statement never just repeats the card before it. | A true or false statement tests one claim.

sonnet.problem: Verse 7:6 is told after cards that already covered 7:7, 7:8-9 and 7:10. Card 7 tells 7:7 before 7:6, and card 11 then goes back to 7:6, so the cards are out of passage order.
sonnet.rule: Cards follow the passage in order.
